title: DOW-UAP-D097, Project Sign Progress Report, 1948
what_is_it: A 1948 progress report from the US Air Force's Air Materiel Command on Project Sign, its early UFO investigation programme (image/scanned document).
interpretation_warnings: No machine-readable text was extracted from this document; all fields are derived from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the document body itself.
Facts such as the '100 sightings' figure and the included magazine article come from the CSV description, not verified against the scanned page content.
Project Sign was an early, exploratory programme; its report should be read as a period document reflecting 1948 understanding, not a settled conclusion.
